template.description: Footage-first captions with bold kinetic word hits directly over the video, native-time corrections and original audio. Clean render uses generated stand-ins, not recorded speech.
template.fixture: Generated color-motion source and sine tone demonstrate layout, not real quote or transcription quality.
template.editorialIntent: Preserve the full picture; use large lime words at lower center with a short pop, no panel or headline. Inspect the supplied face framing and move captions when they obscure important action. Clear gaps after 750ms.
